hotel_name: Lime Tree Hotel Sushant Lok Gurgaon At Iffco Metro Close To Leisure Valley , Sector 29

positive_snippets: Hotel room is fully furnished and attached with balcony. Facilitated with all basic needs. Sunshine enter with bright room. Good mannered receptionist. Highly recommend.
It was great experience at lime tree hotel. Staff is very friendly . Conditions of the rooms match with the prices.Bathroom are properly clean. Near metro connectvity.
negative_snippets:
Scam Experience. Avoid
We booked this property through Booking.com and paid a token amount. After payment, we were told the booked property was not available and were pushed to accept a different property far from the original location.
We refused and were assured a refund, but were completely ignored and never refunded.
When we posted an honest public review, we were blackmailed into taking it down instead of our issue being resolved.
Highly unprofessional and unethical. Proceed with extreme caution.
